title: Two-fork roadmap demonstration
description: A transfer-ready comparison shell for two private Jira-backed roadmaps. Neutral labels remain until the governed Jira bindings are supplied on the work machine.

forks.label: Roadmap fork 01
forks.purpose: Neutral transfer slot for the first private workflow and its Jira changelog history.

metrics.label: Resolved scope
metrics.detail: Synthetic shape only; Jira resolution history replaces this sample after transfer.

metrics.label: Blocked work
metrics.detail: Synthetic count shaped like Jira issue-link data.

metrics.label: Median cycle time
metrics.detail: Synthetic changelog-derived duration, not a live operational measurement.

actions.label: Bind Jira components to governed verticals
actions.consequence: Until the mapping is supplied, cross-vertical progress and blockers remain unavailable.

actions.label: Resolve the oldest cross-team dependency
actions.consequence: The synthetic critical path remains on watch until this representative dependency clears.

forks.label: Roadmap fork 02
forks.purpose: Neutral transfer slot for the second private workflow so its progress can be compared without merging the plans.

metrics.label: Resolved scope
metrics.detail: Synthetic shape only; Jira resolution history replaces this sample after transfer.

metrics.label: Blocked work
metrics.detail: Synthetic count shaped like Jira issue-link data.

metrics.label: Median cycle time
metrics.detail: Synthetic changelog-derived duration, not a live operational measurement.

actions.label: Bind the second Jira filter and changelog
actions.consequence: Without an exact filter, the alternate fork cannot report scope, aging, or forecast confidence.

actions.label: Decide whether discovered scope stays in this fork
actions.consequence: The representative finish date continues to drift while the scope boundary remains unresolved.
